# Phase 2: Kaggle and laptop run outputs (results/kaggle), every small result file

Per-run done.json (loss logs), retrieval.json, sib meta files, gate and precision outputs, quota ledgers. `repo/` copies, logs, adapters, checkpoints and per-item parquet/npy files are not dumped.

- models: qwen3-8b, sarvam-1, sarvam-m, gemma4-e2b, llama-2-7b, qwen3.5-2b, llama-3.1-8b, ambari-7b-base, ambari-7b-instruct-v0.1, ambari-7b-instruct-v0.2
- forms: lossy, lower, itrans, native, english, natural
- seeds: 0, 1, 2, 3
- conditions: itrans, native, english
